standard-dialogue-man-in-leather-body.npc: I'm ruined, all because of that stupid cat! It has ruined me.
Why did it have to get itself killed? Why?

standard-dialogue-man-in-leather-body.player: Aside* I think I should leave him alone. He seems a little upset right now.

standard-dialogue-shirtless-man.npc: Trying to win my shirt back. I lost it last night in a silly bet.

standard-dialogue-shirtless-man.player: Well I hope your luck improves. I doubt it can get any worse.

standard-dialogue-shirtless-man.npc: Well I've little left to lose, maybe some more hair and my trousers.

standard-dialogue-shirtless-man.player: I really think you should try hold on to them.

standard-dialogue-man-with-top-hat.player: I was just wondering what you were doing here?

standard-dialogue-man-with-top-hat.npc: I ask myself the same question often.
What am I doing down here in these pits along with these filthy dregs of society?

standard-dialogue-man-with-top-hat.player: And do you ever come up with an answer?

standard-dialogue-man-with-top-hat.npc: I'm here taking their money, that's what.

standard-dialogue-man-with-feathered-hat.npc: Just a bit of drinking, a bit of fighting and a few people trying to win big.

standard-dialogue-man-with-feathered-hat.player: Nothing but good clean family fun.

standard-dialogue-woman-in-green.npc: Nothing much. Just keeping myself occupied, placing a couple of wagers here and there.
Yes in the sense that I'm not as bored as I was and no in terms of the number of coins in my purse.

standard-dialogue-woman-in-grey.npc: Trying to win back some money.
In every bet there is a fool and a thief and I'm beginning to think that I'm not much of a thief.

standard-dialogue-woman-with-pink-beret.npc: Having fun. It's such a blast I've already won 5 thousand gold coins today, my cat just keeps winning.

standard-dialogue-after-the-specific-gam.player: So how do these rat pits work?

standard-dialogue-after-the-specific-gam.text: If in the Ardougne rat pit:

steps.npc: Things work simply in the Ardougne ratpits.
If you have a kitten and at least 100 coins you can challenge someone else who also has a kitten and some spare change.

steps.player: That sounds simple enough so far.

steps.npc: You then agree on a wager. It's rumoured that some ratcatchers can talk to their own cats and give them tactics to aid them.

steps.player: So then how do you win the challenge?

steps.npc: I was just getting to that. Both the challengers' cats are placed inside the arena, and whichever kills 5 rats first wins.

standard-dialogue-after-the-specific-gam.text: If in the Varrock rat pit:

steps.npc: It's simple.
In Varrock if you have a grown cat and a couple of coins you can challenge someone else who also has a grown cat and some spare change.

steps.player: That sounds simple enough so far.

steps.npc: You then agree on a wager. It's rumoured that some ratcatchers can talk to their own cats and give them tactics to aid them.

steps.player: So then how do you win the challenge?

steps.npc: I was just getting to that. Both the challengers' cats are placed inside the arena, and whichever kills 7 rats first wins.

standard-dialogue-after-the-specific-gam.text: If in the Port Sarim rat pit:

steps.npc: The Port Sarim pits are quite fussy, no lazy cats allowed in here.

steps.player: Lazy cats?

steps.npc: You know if you neglect a wily cat, it gets fat and lazy? Well, they're not allowed to fight in here, only wily cats.

steps.player: That sounds simple enough so far.

steps.npc: You then agree on a wager. It's rumoured that some ratcatchers can talk to their own cats and give them tactics to aid them.

steps.player: So then how do you win the challenge?

steps.npc: I was just getting to that. Both the challengers' cats are placed inside the arena, and whichever kills 11 rats first wins.

steps.player: That sounds vile and cruel.

steps.npc: It's a cruel world and the pits are no exception.
Each to their own, I say.

steps.player: Thanks for your help.

options.text: It sounds a little dangerous for my cat.

steps.player: It sounds a little dangerous for my cat.

steps.npc: I agree. Cats have been known to be killed in fights.

steps.player: Oh how terrible. Is there nothing you can do to save your cat?

steps.npc: Of course there is, you can instruct it to be cautious, and it will leave once it feels as if it is in danger.

steps.player: Oh that sounds quite wise.

steps.npc: That depends on how you value your cat.

steps.player: Sorry, I don't follow.

steps.npc: Well if your cat dies or it runs away you lose.
So the longer it stays in the fight the better chance you have of winning.

steps.player: Wow that sounds like fun!

steps.npc: I don't know about that.
One thing I know though is that it's a quick way to make and lose money.

options.text: Is there a limit to how much you can bet?

steps.player: Is there a limit to how much you can bet?

steps.npc: Hmmm... let me think. I don't think that's ever arisen but I think it's 20,000.

steps.player: Hmm, that sounds like a silly amount of money to bet on a cat fight.

steps.npc: You'd be surprised what some people would be willing to bet.
There is a minimum bet of 100 coins too.

options.text: Can I challenge you and your cat?

steps.player: Can I challenge you and your cat?

steps.npc: No, not now, we don't really bet with outsiders.

steps.player: But I'm not an outsider, am I not inside in the pits now?

steps.npc: I don't know, maybe once you've done something to win over my trust.

steps.player: Can it be bought?

steps.npc: What?

steps.player: Your trust.

steps.npc: No. Regular townsfolk don't like us, which leads us to distrust them and anyone else.
